rss: AI boom could trigger market shocks, Bank of England boss warns
title: Robots Are Making Big Waves!
story: Lots of people are spending money on robots. This could make some things in the market change quickly.
storyBig: The rapid growth of AI investments could cause fluctuations in financial markets. It's important for investors to stay alert to these market changes.
think: What would you buy if you were a robot maker?
bull: Robots can help us do things faster and better.
bear: Too many robot investments could be risky if they don't work out.

rss: The AI telling farmers when to harvest
title: Robots Help Farmers Pick!
story: Some farmers are using robots to know the best time to pick their crops. This makes farming easier!
storyBig: AI tools are being used to optimize harvest times for better crop yields. However, farmers must decide whether to rely on technology or their own expertise.
think: Would you trust a robot to help you plant a garden?
bull: Robots can help make farming easier and more fun.
bear: Relying too much on robots could be tricky if they make mistakes.
